description: On E019's Muon recipe at 8.5 epochs, raise the batch size from 1024 to 2000. Scale the SGD param groups (BN/bias/head) by the same kilostep rule as E010, and scale the EMA/lookahead schedule by the step count. Keep Muon lr 0.24 and momentum 0.6, which are airbench94_muon's own settings at bs 2000. Warm up the new shapes in build. This tests whether Muon removes the large-batch penalty SGD showed (E010: -0.81 pp) while halving the per-step Muon overhead.
